code:
ServiceNow  --REST call-->  External system
            <--waits for response--

Calling transaction's speed = External system's speed
External system down  =>  ServiceNow transaction fails or hangs
caption: Simple to build and reason about — but a real latency dependency.

code:
ServiceNow  --publishes event-->  Message channel  -->  Subscriber(s)
            (doesn't wait)                                 (act independently)

Open questions: event order? delivered twice? never delivered?
caption: Resilient — but ordering and delivery guarantees are real design work.
